design: fresh paired OFF/ON execution on the single treatment-blind unseen task satisfying the frozen adopted-bridge applicability rule
primary_interpretation: agent task success must not regress under ON
measure whether adopted-bridge preservation produces a historical-fix-adjacent critical DROP-to-KEEP rescue
measure additional non-critical retention introduced by treatment

critical_evidence_oracle.construction: production-file lines around the historical source fix hunk, evaluated only when corresponding evidence is naturally retrieved and scorable
critical_evidence_oracle.role: retention proxy, not proof of causal bug relevance

mechanism_metrics: which exact records are newly retained by the floor

stale_adoption_exploratory_metric.question: Does adopted evidence continue receiving preservation after the agent has stopped reusing the adopted identifier in later retrieval actions?
stale_adoption_exploratory_metric.method: post-run exact-wire replay of the frozen ON requests with instrumentation; identify the last observed agent retrieval reuse of the identifier and count later adopted-floor preservation events
stale_adoption_exploratory_metric.interpretation: exploratory mechanism analysis only; no algorithm changes will be made from this holdout

success_criteria.strong_positive: at least one unseen critical DROP-to-KEEP rescue, zero critical KEEP-to-DROP regressions, low additional non-critical burden, and ON task success no worse than OFF
success_criteria.negative_transfer: no unseen critical rescue or harmful regression; report without further feature tuning
